desc: Write Python program implementing iterative FFT (Cooley-Tukey) using `cmath`, reading N and S list.
Build boolean indicator array of size `max(S)+1`; pad to next power of two ≥ 2*max(S).
Compute forward FFT of the array, square the transformed array, then inverse FFT; round to nearest integer.
Iterate through each b in S, add `conv[2*b] // 2` to the answer; print the result.
Test the code on the three sample inputs to confirm correct outputs (3, 5, 10).
Validate handling of edge cases (N < 3, all values small) and rounding errors in convolution.
If performance is insufficient, optimize FFT inner loops (e.g., precompute twiddle factors, bind local variables, consider PyPy or numpy) to meet time limits for worst-case M=1e6.
Finalize solution and ensure robust input reading and output formatting.
